field.label: Block Response
field.help: How a blocked query is answered: zeroIp for 0.0.0.0, nxDomain for a non-existent domain, or a comma separated list of IP addresses to answer with.

field.label: Block TTL
field.help: How long clients may cache a blocked answer.

field.label: Refresh Period
field.help: How often lists are downloaded again. Use 0s to only load them at startup.

field.label: Startup Strategy
field.help: What blocky does with its lists while starting up.

field.label: Cache Downloads
field.help: Keep a copy of every downloaded list under /var/cache/blocky so that lists survive a reboot or an outage at the list provider.

field.label: Concurrency
field.help: How many lists are downloaded and parsed at the same time.

field.label: Tolerated Errors
field.help: How many unparsable lines a single list may contain before it is rejected. Use -1 to accept any number.

field.label: Download Timeout
field.help: How long a single download attempt may take.

field.label: Download Attempts
field.help: How often a failing download is retried.

field.label: Download Cooldown
field.help: How long to wait between two download attempts.
